name: Time Blocking: Everything You Need to Know
instructions: Group similar tasks into the same block (all emails, all calls) instead of scattering them across the day.
Match task type to your energy: schedule demanding work in your peak-focus hours, routine tasks in your lower-energy hours.
Review how accurately you estimated each block's length at the end of the day, and adjust tomorrow's blocks accordingly.
Watch today's video for the full deep dive on time blocking.
